notes.title: Buying committee
notes.body: Avery signs ops. Sam has to approve any seat split over $5k. Do not send one invoice for both workspaces.

notes.title: Design-tool stack
notes.body: They already pay for Figma. Pilot needs to feel like a complement, not another canvas.

notes.title: Why we lost
notes.body: Price was fine. They had unused seats on the incumbent and a cancellation fee through March 2027.

notes.title: Site constraints
notes.body: Houston yard has spotty LTE on the south fence. Offline mode is a must-have in the proposal.

notes.title: Clinic hours
notes.body: Onsite onboarding has to start after 6pm. Daytime floor is full.

notes.title: Brand kit files
notes.body: Nina will send autumn SKU photos next week. Hold the expansion invoice until those land.
